mechanism.claim: The squared duration mass of positive versus negative one-minute candle-body runs over a completed UTC day measures persistent directional auction control without using return magnitude. The dominant run-duration side should persist over the following twelve hours.
mechanism.side: sign(sum positive run_length^2 - sum negative run_length^2)
mechanism.why_distinct: TSPI uses the complete distribution of maximal nonzero one-minute body-sign run durations at one weekly clock. It is not sign entropy, body count, maximum run, return magnitude, multi-horizon trend, funding, flow, volatility gating, or a model.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: directional auction persistence is evaluated full-calendar and later decomposed on the causal RV20 q90 slice against a forced-long comparator
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one twelve-hour Wednesday position per week

features.body_sign: sign(log(close_i/open_i)); exact zero terminates a run
features.runs: maximal contiguous equal nonzero body-sign sequences
features.positive_mass: sum squared lengths of all positive runs
features.negative_mass: sum squared lengths of all negative runs
features.eligibility: exact minute grid, unique timestamps, finite positive coherent OHLC, and at least one positive and one negative body; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.daily_return: log(C_d/C_{d-1}) assigned to UTC calendar day d
rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) over exact returns t-20 through t-1
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear 0.90 quantile over 756 available RV20 observations with decision timestamps strictly before t; current excluded
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: report-only until all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: each Wednesday 00:00 UTC after the prior 24 hours are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.full_calendar_decomposition: candidate net return minus comparator net return
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition restricted by causal RV20 at decision

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no weekday, window, run transform, direction, entry, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
